post.summary: Receive up to 64 durable telephony callbacks atomically
post.description: Requires the same webhook token, timestamp and HMAC signature as batch v1. Maximum body 256 KiB (or the configured smaller platform limit). The entire envelope is validated before writes; duplicate identities retain their original body digest and same-call FIFO. Returns 200 only after durable receipt commit. The original batch endpoint remains limited to 16 events / 64 KiB.

200.description: version=2, result=received and exactly the accepted event IDs

409.description: Event identity/body conflict or durable batching disabled

503.description: Durable receipt capacity unavailable; retry the same identities
